incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated request error rate and route churn detected for model-serving across regions (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). Auto-created incident thread. Root_ts=2190012345

maya (oncall): I'm seeing 5xxs spike and the smart-router logs show back-and-forth failover between us-east and us-west. eu is intermittently taking traffic then dropping it. Paging SRE.

samir (sre): looking. Can you paste the router trace for a single request id? I want to see the sequence of fallbacks.

maya (oncall): pasted a 1m snippet below (sanitized):
```
router: request=rx-84f2 -> prefer: us-east
health-check us-east: PASS
route -> us-east
latency 42ms, tokens ok
health-check us-east: FAIL
router: trigger fallback -> us-west
health-check us-west: PASS
route -> us-west
health-check us-west: FAIL
router: fallback -> eu
health-check eu: PASS
route -> eu
health-check eu: FAIL
router: back to us-east
...oscillation...
```

samir (sre): that's classic probe-flap-driven routing. The healthcheck TTL/hysteresis on these probes is too short, and route preference weights are causing immediate failovers instead of degrading gracefully. Also noticed a correlated model-variant mismatch on us-west (fallback variant incompatible with kv-cache layout) causing elevated 5xxs when traffic lands there.

olivia (runtime): confirmed. Metrics show probe interval 5s with failure threshold=1 on the region probe propagation. That explains immediate flip. Also the model variant in us-west got auto-fallback to `redwood-legacy-quant-v1` due to a rollout rule; that variant has an older tokenization shim. When requests hit it, runtime throws 502s intermittently.

leo (netops): if we stabilize probes and prefer a single stable region, we can blunt the loop quickly. Propose steps:
1) increase probe failure threshold to 3 (hysteresis)
2) temporarily set route affinity to prefer us-east with weight 95%
3) disable automatic variant fallback for the affected model to force compatible variant only

maya (oncall): agree. What's the minimal CLI to change preference and probe threshold?

samir (sre): run these from the control plane (safe ops window):
```
# raise failure threshold from 1 -> 3
rictl probes update --region all --probe-name region-health --failure-threshold 3

# set region preference hard (temporary)
rictl routing set-preference --model-id model-abc123 --region us-east --weight 95

# disable auto-fallback to legacy variants
rictl models update --model-id model-abc123 --allow-legacy-fallback false
```

olivia (runtime): I'll patch the model catalog rule now (disallow fallback) and push a safe change with no restart.

ops-pager: :pager: Customer-impact: ~11% of requests in the last 10m returned 5xx. Top affected customers: acme-corp (10% of their calls), beta-saas (5% increased latency). No data exfiltration.

ethan (product): heads-up to support to flag impacted tenants. Can we get a rough ETA on mitigation?

maya (oncall): executing the probe update and routing preference now. Will post output.

maya (oncall): (running)
```
$ rictl probes update --region all --probe-name region-health --failure-threshold 3
Success: updated probe config for regions: us-east, us-west, eu
```

maya (oncall): (running)
```
$ rictl routing set-preference --model-id model-abc123 --region us-east --weight 95
Success: routing preference applied (temp until 2190013050)
```

incident-bot: config-change: probe-config and routing preference updated by maya (oncall). Alert muted for 5m while system stabilizes.

samir (sre): I also pushed the model catalog change to prevent fallback to legacy variant. That was the root cause on us-west. We should see the 502 volume drop as soon as in-flight connections drain.

olivia (runtime): metrics are improving: 5xx rate reduced from 11% -> 2.3% over 3 minutes. Route churn has dropped (no flip events seen in router logs for 120s).

leo (netops): I'm going to pause cross-region probe propagation temporarily to avoid propagation of intermediate FAILs while we stabilize.

leo (netops): (running)
```
$ rictl probes pause --scope cross-region --duration 10m --reason "mitigation: stop flap propagation"
Success: cross-region probe propagation paused for 10m
```

ops-pager: updated impact: now 1.8% 5xx across global traffic; affected customer call volume down to background noise. Continuing to monitor.

ethan (product): thanks team. I'll coordinate a customer note and let support triage ACME and Beta.

maya (oncall): handing off to samir for post-stabilization checks. I'm going offline in ~30m. Summary to include in pager: root cause = probe hysteresis too low + catalog fallback to incompatible legacy model variant; mitigation = raised failure-threshold, set regional preference to us-east, disabled legacy fallback, paused cross-region probe propagation.

samir (sre): taking over. Next actions:
- let traffic stabilize for 30m
- revert the pause and keep hysteresis=3 (or tune after p99 window)
- create a follow-up to harden model-fallback rules and add unit tests preventing incompatible variant auto-selection
- postmortem owner: samir

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked "stabilized" at 2190012402 by samir. Severity: Sev2 -> will be downgraded after SLO window.

maya (oncall): thanks. Leaving notes in the incident runbook and tagging postmortem.

samir (sre): quick logs for artifacting: saving router-trace and probe events to s3://incidents/2190012345/trace.log
```
# short grep for flip count
grep "fallback ->" trace.log | wc -l -> 72 flips in 10m
```

ethan (product): customer comms drafted, will wait for final confirmation before sending.

samir (sre): assigning follow-ups:
- samir: postmortem + remediation plan (config guardrails, tests)
- olivia: runtime change to disallow variant fallback for incompatible tokenizers
- leo: add hysteresis default to routing probes (from 1 -> 3)
- maya: handoff notes and timeline

ops-pager: Incident closed to active state. Monitoring continues for 2h.

samir (sre): final note: root fix will include a control-plane safety check that rejects fallback variants whose model-metadata tokenizer/kv layout != primary. Ticket in tracker: INF-8341.

maya (oncall): good catch team. :thumbsup:
